substack.email_subject: Ten minutes at Xerox PARC changed what a computer was for.
substack.note:
In December 1979, Steve Jobs watched a ten-minute demo at Xerox PARC: a pointer moving across a screen of overlapping windows. Within days, he had reorganized part of Apple's engineering team around it.

He didn't invent the mouse or the graphical interface. He saw what it would take to hand them to an ordinary person.
